title: Electroflight | Fully Charged
summary: A Fully Charged episode on Electroflight, an early-stage project to build a fully electric racing plane that can exceed 300 mph. It features two motors driving contra-rotating propellers.
why: HN points to it in electric aviation threads for how small electric motors enable contra-rotating props.

quote.text: If you're interested in the electrification of flight check out this episode of Fully Charged
